Players Committee card image of [[Wooof (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. May deploy with any cruiser using Combat Response. While aboard an [Independent] starship, opponent's battle and weapon destiny draws here are -1.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/wooof.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
